channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Hacker accesses info on 1.2 mn French bank accounts
item.description: The French economy ministry said Wednesday that a hacker gained access to a national bank account database and consulted information on 1.2 million accounts.

item.title: French word of the day: Zouave
item.description: From the military to a political group and a statue - this French word has a lot of different meanings.

item.title: French transport police to trial stun guns on trains
item.description: Several hundred officers who police France's trains and the Paris Metro are to be armed with stun guns on an experimental basis in a bid to increase security, Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot said on Thursday.

item.title: Eurostar station boss pledges to cut boarding times
item.description: Passengers on the Eurostar could be spared the airport-style waiting times in the future, as bosses at London St Pancras station pledge to cut boarding times for cross-Channel passengers.

item.title: 'Systemic failures' led to Louvre robbery, inquiry finds
item.description: "Systemic failures" led to the €88-million robbery at the Louvre museum in Paris last year, MPs leading an inquiry said on Thursday, raising pressure on embattled director Laurence des Cars.

item.title: Record €150k fine for illegal Airbnb rental in Paris
item.description: 'It's the end of impunity', said Paris city authorities as they announced record fines of €80,000 and €150,000 for two Paris apartment owners who had rented their properties out on Airbnb without the correct authorisation.

item.title: Why so many Americans are moving to Montpellier
item.description: With its sunny weather, car-free lifestyle and good travel links, the elegant southern French city of Montpellier is attracting more and more Americans. We spoke to some long-term residents about what attracted them.

item.title: Seven reasons to move to Montpellier
item.description: It sometimes flies under the radar, but for resident Marc Wisbey, Montpellier is the perfect French town. He explains why we should all move there.

item.title: 36 days and counting: When will it ever stop raining in France?
item.description: With France having already broken a record for 36 consecutive days of rain the question being asked, in increasingly shrill tones, is when will the wet weather end?

item.title: French prosecutor seeks murder charges for seven suspects in far-right activist killing
item.description: A French prosecutor said on Thursday he has requested "intentional homicide" charges be made against seven men after the fatal beating of a far-right activist in Lyon last week.
